title: ADR-0106 D6: record that a throw from the _withheldFields security member degrades to drop-all (fail-closed hint), not 5xx — the decision PR #34979 makes
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6967038502, after 6966984093 item 2).

## The decision to record
PR #34979 (#34901) decides that when the security member answering the `_withheldFields` question **throws**, every `_withheldFields` entry is **dropped**, a fail-closed hint, rather than the request answering 5xx.

ADR-0106 D6's table reads a throw as 5xx. The seat and L1-d agree that D6's 5xx is about the field-access question itself, and that dropping a hint leaks nothing.

## Done when
D6 gains one row or note: the `_withheldFields` hint question degrades to drop-all on a member throw, citing #34979. Without it, the code reads as a breach of the ADR's letter.

It is kept out of #34979 because an ADR file would make that PR governed (Tier H) partway through its delta review. ADR files are a governed surface, so this needs L2.

Grade: **p2 · domain:server**. Under addendum 5, an ADR change that records a decision is graded by its theme (HotCRM usable, the #34901 family), not as pure wording. No user effect beyond doc fidelity.
